description: This Java class provides utility methods for file handling within the RomRaider project, including file selection dialogs, saving user profiles, and managing directories.

classes.name: FileHelper
classes.description: A utility class for handling file operations such as opening file choosers, saving profiles, and managing directories.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns a File object based on the provided file path or the user's home directory if the path is null or empty.

methods.name: getProfileFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser configured for selecting ECU Logger User Profile XML files.

methods.name: getDefinitionFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser configured for selecting ECU Logger Definition XML files.

methods.name: saveProfileToFile
methods.description: Saves a UserProfile object to a specified file, appending .xml extension if missing.

methods.name: getLoggerOutputDirFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser for selecting a directory for logger output, defaulting to the last used directory if valid.

methods.name: getFileChooser
methods.description: Helper method to create a JFileChooser with a specific file filter.

methods.name: getFileChooser
methods.description: Helper method to create a JFileChooser initialized to a specific file's directory.
